load_fasttext_model: load a binarized fastText model from a file path and return the model object
read_txt_embeddings: read pretrained word embeddings from a text file and return a word-to-id mapping with torch tensor embeddings
load_bin_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a fastText binary file and return a word-to-id mapping with torch tensor embeddings
load_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from either a text or fastText binary file based on file extension
review_pretrain_embeddings: review the python module pretrain.py functions for loading and parsing pretrained word embeddings
